title: 第1章 干姜闻一炮
content_zh:
“沟槽的姜闻！”

    一个约莫二十来岁的男人，一巴掌拍在桌子上。

    “听说拍《寻枪》的时候，他把你骂哭了？”

    陆穿小声的说道：“没骂哭。”

    “那就是骂了！”谷川吼道：“他不知道你是我兄弟？”

    陆穿瞥了一眼谷川。

    没说话。

    他知道你是谁啊。

    谷川的父亲和他父亲是老相识，谷川小时候，也经常来找他。

    不过当时自己不愿意搭理这个小屁孩。

    后来，谷川就跟着他父亲出国去了。

    他也是才知道谷川回国，然后联系上的。

    谷川撸起袖子，拽着陆穿就要往外走。

    “走，我带你去干他一炮！”

    “唉？”

    陆穿惊了，脚下像是生了根一样，不敢乱动。

    他惊慌的说道：“算了吧？姜闻他人高马大的，就是一活土匪。”

    “怕什么？我不能让我兄弟白挨揍了！”谷川说道。

    陆穿胳膊被拉着，人还是坠在后面。

    他怕打不过，然后挨揍。

    谷川虽然一米八的个，虽然挺帅的，但看上去比姜闻瘦，还一股子文弱气息，不像是能打架的。

    你总不能去帅死人家吧？

    他自己，估计也是受不住姜闻一拳的货。

    “别怕！”

    谷川拍着胸脯说道：“咱们二打一，还怕他姜闻？而且，咱们还可以搞偷袭，干他一炮就跑！”

    陆穿还是有点怂。

    “你TM的怎么那么软！”谷川恨铁不成钢的说道：“姜闻就是看你这么软，好欺负，才欺负你的！”

    见陆穿软塌塌的样子，谷川说道：“到时候要打不过，我站你后面，帮你挡住姜闻，让他揍我，给你争取逃跑时间。”

    “我不是那意思。”陆穿说道。

    “那就跟我走！”

    陆穿一咬牙，跟了上去。

    反正谷川说了，他会在后面挡着姜闻，怕什么。

    一想到姜闻那张脸，他就是恨的牙痒痒。

    从小到大，他就没受过这样的委屈。
content_en:
"Gutter's Jiang Wen!"

    A man in his twenties slapped his hand on the table.

    "I heard that he made you cry while filming "Hunter"?"

    Lu Chuan said softly: "I'm not scolding or crying."

    "That's scolding!" Tanichuan shouted: "He doesn't know you are my brother?"

    Lu Chuan glanced at Tanichuan.

    No words were spoken.

    He knows who you are.

    Tanichuan's father and his father were old acquaintances, and Tanichuan often came to see him when he was a child.

    But at that time, I didn't want to deal with this little brat.

    Later, Tanichuan went abroad with his father.

    He also just learned that Tanichuan had returned to China and then contacted him.

    Tanichuan rolled up his sleeves, pulled Lu Chuan and started to walk out.

    "Let's go, I'll take you to fuck him!"

    "Huh?"

    Lu Chuan was shocked, as if there were roots under his feet and he didn't dare to move.

    He said in panic: "Forget it? Jiang Wen said that he is a bandit."

    "What are you afraid of? I can't let my brother get beaten in vain!" Tanichuan said.

    Lu Chuan's arm was pulled, but he still fell behind.

    He was afraid that he would not be able to defeat him and would be beaten.

    Although Tanichuan is 1.8 meters tall and quite handsome, he looks thinner than Jiang Wen and has a weak air. He doesn't look like he can fight.

    You can't just be so handsome, right?

    He himself probably couldn't stand Jiang Wen's punch.

    "Don't be afraid!"

    Tanichuan patted his chest and said: "We are two against one, and we are still afraid of Jiang Wen? Moreover, we can also conduct a sneak attack, and he will run away with one shot!"

    Lu Chuan was still a little timid.

    "Why are you so damn soft!" Tanichuan said angrily, "Jiang Wen bullied you just because he thought you were so soft and easy to bully!"

    Seeing Lu Chuan's limp appearance, Tanichuan said, "If you can't beat him when the time comes, I'll stand behind you and help you block Jiang Wen. Let him beat me and buy you time to escape."

    "That's not what I meant." Lu Chuan said.

    "Then come with me!"

    Lu Chuan gritted his teeth and followed.

    Anyway, Gu Chuan said that he would block Jiang Wen from behind, so what was he afraid of?

    When he thought of Jiang Wen's face, his teeth itched with hatred.

    He has never suffered such injustice since he was a child.
